commentPin.toast.postedBuilding.text: Posted to {{place}}. Homeroom bot is building it.
commentPin.toast.postedBuilding.description: Toast after a request written in comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot, posted as a request to improve the app or Homeroom) was posted and Homeroom's bot started building it. {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom. 'Homeroom bot' is the name of the platform's coding agent.

commentPin.toast.posted.description: Toast after a request written in comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot, posted as a request to improve the app or Homeroom) was posted. {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom.

commentPin.shot.none.description: Line beside the pictures in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) after the person removed the screenshots: the request will be posted without them.

commentPin.shot.taking.description: Line beside the pictures in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) while the picture of the page is still being captured.

commentPin.shot.attached.text: Screenshot of this page, with your pin
commentPin.shot.attached.description: Line beside the screenshot thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), when the request has one comment: a screenshot showing where the person placed their pin will be attached.

commentPin.shot.failed.text: No screenshot. Your words still go.
commentPin.shot.failed.description: Line beside the pictures in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when no picture of the page could be taken and no image was added: the request is still posted, without a picture.

commentPin.shot.remove.description: Tooltip of the small ✕ on the screenshot thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): posts the request without the screenshots.

commentPin.shot.addBack.description: Small button after "No screenshot." in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), after the screenshots were removed: attaches them again.

commentPin.textLabel.description: Accessible name of the text box in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) where the person writes their comment, when the request has only one.

commentPin.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the first comment's text box in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): asks what the person wants different at the spot they pinned.

commentPin.target.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the pair of choices in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) that decide whether the request is sent to the app the person is in or to Homeroom itself.

commentPin.target.to.description: Short label before the two destination choices in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) (the app's name, and Homeroom): the request is sent to the chosen one. A preposition, as on a letter.

commentPin.target.toHomeroom.description: Line in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when there is no app to choose: the request is sent to Homeroom, the platform. Homeroom is the product name.

commentPin.posting.description: Label of the post button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) while the request is being sent.

commentPin.post.description: Post button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the request has one comment. A verb: posts the comment as a request.

commentPin.postFailed.description: Error line in the pinned-comment box when the server refused the comment and gave no reason of its own.

staging.banner.solo.text: Preview of your change. It goes live when you vote it in. Anything you add here stays in the preview and won't carry over.
staging.banner.solo.description: Line under the top bar of the staging preview, on a project that only its creator belongs to. Says the previewed change is not live until they approve it, and that data entered in the preview is not copied to the live app.

staging.banner.group.text: Preview of this change. Members can try it before they vote. Anything you add here stays in the preview and won't carry over.
staging.banner.group.description: Line under the top bar of the staging preview, on a project with several members. Says the change can be tried before voting, and that data entered in the preview is not copied to the live app.

staging.clock.showingNow.text: Showing it as it is now.
staging.clock.showingNow.description: Line in the staging preview when the change declared a particular moment to be shown at, and the viewer chose to see the preview at the present time instead.

staging.clock.showingAt.description: Line in the staging preview saying which moment the preview pretends it is, because the change only shows at certain times. {{moment}} is a date and time already in words, for example 'Thursday 8 Oct, 7 pm'.

staging.clock.seeAt.description: Button in the staging preview: reloads the preview as if it were the moment the change declared. {{moment}} is a date and time already in words, for example 'Thursday 8 Oct, 7 pm'.

staging.clock.seeNow.description: Button in the staging preview: reloads the preview at the present time instead of the moment the change declared.

staging.testThisChange.description: Button in the staging preview's top bar: opens the coding agent's instructions for how to try the previewed change.

staging.fullScreen.description: Button in the top bar of the staging preview while it is docked beside the dev chat: expands the preview to cover the whole screen.

staging.openConsole.description: Accessible name of the terminal-icon button in the staging preview's top bar: opens the panel that lists the previewed app's console messages.

staging.closePreview.description: Accessible name of the × button on the staging preview while it is docked beside the dev chat: closes the preview panel.

staging.howToTest.description: Heading of the small panel over the staging preview that holds the coding agent's instructions for trying the change.

staging.dismissTesting.description: Accessible name of the × button on the 'How to test' panel in the staging preview: hides the panel.

staging.loader.opening.description: Title beside the spinner that covers the staging preview while it is being opened.

staging.loader.retrySignIn.description: Button under the spinner in the staging preview when signing the person in to the previewed app failed: tries the sign-in again.

staging.compare.dialogLabel.description: Accessible name of the full-screen overlay that shows a screen before and after a change, side by side.

console.title.description: Title of the panel at the bottom of the screen that lists an app's console messages (errors, warnings and logs) for people building it.

console.filter.all.description: Option in the developer console filter: show console messages of every level.

console.filter.errors.description: Option in the developer console filter: show only error messages.

console.filter.warnings.description: Option in the developer console filter: show only warning messages.

console.filter.info.description: Option in the developer console filter: show only messages logged at the 'info' level.

console.filter.log.description: Option in the developer console filter: show only messages logged at the plain 'log' level. A noun, the console level's name.

console.filter.debug.description: Option in the developer console filter: show only messages logged at the 'debug' level. The console level's name, not an instruction.

console.clear.description: Button in the developer console header: empties the list of console messages.

console.empty.text: No messages yet. If this app was created before dev-console support shipped, ask the coding agent in Dev Chat to "add dev-console forwarding to public/index.html".
console.empty.description: Hint at the bottom of the developer console while it has no messages. The quoted sentence is an instruction the person can give the coding agent, and public/index.html is a file name: keep the file name as it is.

console.counts.description: Summary in the developer console header. {{total}} is the number of console messages, {{errors}} how many are errors and {{warnings}} how many are warnings; 'err' and 'warn' are short for those. Keep it compact.

banner.sync.busyTitle.text: Claude is busy with a turn. Sync will be available when it finishes
banner.sync.busyTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled 'Sync with main' and 'Try again' buttons in the dev chat's sync banner while the coding agent is working. Claude is the agent's name; a 'turn' is one request the agent is working through.

banner.sync.syncing.description: Disabled button in the dev chat's sync banner while the session's branch is being brought up to date with the app's main branch.

banner.sync.tryAgain.description: Button in the dev chat's sync banner after bringing the branch up to date with main failed: runs the sync again.

banner.sync.behind_one.text: main has moved <0>{{count}}</0> commit ahead of this branch.
banner.sync.behind_one.description: Banner at the top of a dev chat session when the app's main branch has newer commits than this session's branch. 'main' is the branch's name and stays lower case. {{count}} is the number of commits; keep the <0> tags around it.

banner.sync.behind_other.text: main has moved <0>{{count}}</0> commits ahead of this branch.
banner.sync.behind_other.description: Banner at the top of a dev chat session when the app's main branch has newer commits than this session's branch. 'main' is the branch's name and stays lower case. {{count}} is the number of commits; keep the <0> tags around it.

banner.sync.syncWithMain.description: Button in the dev chat's sync banner: merges the app's main branch into this session's branch. 'main' is the branch's name.

banner.newChange.proposed.text: This change has been proposed to the group (PR #{{number}}). New work in this chat is added to the same PR, so start a new change to keep PRs focused.
banner.newChange.proposed.description: Banner at the top of a dev chat session whose change is already up for the group's vote. {{number}} is the pull request's number; PR is short for pull request.

banner.newChange.merged.text: This change has been merged (PR #{{number}}). New work in this chat is added to the same PR, so start a new change to keep PRs focused.
banner.newChange.merged.description: Banner at the top of a dev chat session whose change was already merged into the app. {{number}} is the pull request's number; PR is short for pull request.

banner.newChange.openCard.description: Link in the dev chat banner shown once a change was proposed or merged: goes to the page for this change's proposal, where its vote, checks and discussion are. 'Open' is a verb; 'proposal' is the change put up for a vote.

banner.newChange.start.description: Main button in the dev chat banner shown once a change was proposed or merged: starts a fresh session for separate work. 'Change' is a noun, a piece of work on the app.

banner.credits.hide.description: Toggle on the dev chat's AI-credits banner on a phone, while its details are showing: collapses the banner back to one line.

banner.credits.details.description: Toggle on the dev chat's AI-credits banner on a phone: shows the rest of the banner (when credits come back and the ways to keep working).

banner.agentSession.text.text: This change belongs to one of your agent sessions. Continue there to revise it.
banner.agentSession.text.description: Banner at the top of a dev chat session whose change was started from one of the person's conversations with the coding agent (an agent session): further edits are made in that conversation.

banner.agentSession.continue.description: Link styled as a button in the dev chat banner about a change that belongs to an agent session: opens that conversation so the person can keep working on the change there.

banner.classic.text.text: This is an older session. You can read it, but it can no longer be continued. New work happens in agent sessions.
banner.classic.text.description: Banner at the top of an old-style dev chat session, which is now read-only. 'Agent sessions' are the newer conversations with the coding agent.

banner.classic.start.description: Button in the banner on a read-only older dev chat session: starts a new conversation with the coding agent on the same app.

runner.pastTitle.text: The last turn ran on {{machine}}. That machine has detached, so the next turn runs on Homeroom.
runner.pastTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Last turn' chip above the dev chat message box. {{machine}} is the name of the person's own computer that ran the coding agent's last request and has since disconnected.

runner.pastTitleUnnamed.text: The last turn ran on your machine. That machine has detached, so the next turn runs on Homeroom.
runner.pastTitleUnnamed.description: Tooltip on the 'Last turn' chip above the dev chat message box. Used when the person's own computer has no name; it is called "your machine", as the tooltip has always read. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent.

runner.lastTurn.description: Chip above the dev chat message box: the coding agent's last request ran on the person's own computer. {{machine}} is that computer's name.

runner.runOn.description: Label before the dropdown above the dev chat message box that chooses where the coding agent runs: the person's own computer, or Homeroom. 'Run' is a verb.

runner.liveTitle.text: Plan and coding turns in this session run on {{machine}}, using its own Claude subscription. A plan turn is read-only; after a coding turn Homeroom still opens the PR, builds the preview and runs the checks.
runner.liveTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Running on your machine' chip above the dev chat message box. {{machine}} is the name of the person's own computer. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent; a plan turn writes the plan for a change, a coding turn builds it; PR is short for pull request.

runner.liveTitleUnnamed.text: Plan and coding turns in this session run on your machine, using its own Claude subscription. A plan turn is read-only; after a coding turn Homeroom still opens the PR, builds the preview and runs the checks.
runner.liveTitleUnnamed.description: Tooltip on the 'Running on your machine' chip above the dev chat message box. Used when the person's own computer has no name; it is called "your machine", as the tooltip has always read. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent; a plan turn writes the plan for a change, a coding turn builds it.

runner.onYourMachine.description: Chip above the dev chat message box while the coding agent for this session runs on the person's own computer rather than on Homeroom.

composer.attachTitle.text: Attach files: images (≤4 MB), text/code files (≤200 KB), zip archives (≤20 MB), or any other file (≤10 MB); up to 4 per message
composer.attachTitle.description: Tooltip on the + button in the dev chat message box, listing what can be attached and the size limits.

composer.attach.description: Accessible name of the + button in the dev chat message box: picks files to send with the message.

composer.sendTitle.description: Tooltip on the send button in the dev chat message box. Ctrl+Enter is the keyboard shortcut; keep the key names.

composer.send.description: Accessible name of the round arrow button in the dev chat message box: sends the message to the coding agent.

composer.saveDraftTitle.text: Save this text as a draft (Ctrl+Enter). It stays here until you send it
composer.saveDraftTitle.description: Tooltip on the save button that replaces Send in the dev chat message box while the coding agent is working. Ctrl+Enter is the keyboard shortcut; keep the key names.

composer.saveDraft.description: Accessible name of the button that replaces Send in the dev chat message box while the coding agent is working: keeps the typed text as a saved draft.

composer.stop.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the round button in the dev chat message box while the coding agent is working: stops the agent's current request.

composer.stoppingLabel.description: Accessible name of the disabled round button in the dev chat message box after Stop was pressed, while the coding agent is being stopped.

composer.stopping.description: Tooltip and visible label of the disabled round button in the dev chat message box after Stop was pressed, while the coding agent is being stopped.

composer.modelLabel.description: Accessible name of the dropdown in the dev chat message box that chooses which AI model answers and whose API key pays for it.

composer.appliesNextTurn.description: Small note beside the model dropdown in the dev chat message box after the model was changed while the coding agent is working: the new model is used from the agent's next request. Lower case, it follows the dropdown.

drafts.sendTitleBusy.text: Claude is still working. You can send this when the turn finishes
drafts.sendTitleBusy.description: Tooltip on a saved draft's disabled send button in the dev chat while the coding agent (Claude) is working on a request.

drafts.sendTitle.description: Tooltip on a saved draft's send button in the dev chat.

drafts.heading_one.text: Saved drafts ({{count}}) <0>· on all your devices</0>
drafts.heading_one.description: Heading of the list of saved drafts above the dev chat message box. {{count}} is how many drafts are saved. The part inside the <0> tags is a quieter note that the drafts follow the person to every device; keep the tags and the dot.

drafts.heading_other.text: Saved drafts ({{count}}) <0>· on all your devices</0>
drafts.heading_other.description: Heading of the list of saved drafts above the dev chat message box. {{count}} is how many drafts are saved. The part inside the <0> tags is a quieter note that the drafts follow the person to every device; keep the tags and the dot.

drafts.sendingLocked.description: Note at the end of the saved-drafts heading in the dev chat while the coding agent (Claude) is working: drafts cannot be sent until it is done. Lower case, it follows the heading.

drafts.send.description: Accessible name of a saved draft's send button in the dev chat.

drafts.edit.description: Accessible name of a saved draft's pencil button in the dev chat.

drafts.editTitle.text: Put this draft back in the box to edit
drafts.editTitle.description: Tooltip on a saved draft's pencil button in the dev chat: moves the draft's text back into the message box.

drafts.delete.description: Accessible name and tooltip of a saved draft's bin button in the dev chat.

connector.urlLabel.description: Label over, and accessible name of, the read-only field in the connector setup card that holds the address the person pastes into Claude or ChatGPT. MCP is a protocol's name.

connector.copyUrl.description: Accessible name of the Copy button beside the server address in the connector setup card.

connector.copyFailed.description: Label the Copy button beside the server address shows for a moment when copying to the clipboard did not work.

connector.copyFailedToast.text: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it manually
connector.copyFailedToast.description: Toast when copying the connector's server address to the clipboard did not work.

connector.lead.description: Heading of the connector setup card in the dev chat. {{product}} is the chat product the person will hand the work to: Claude or ChatGPT. A connector is what lets that product act on Homeroom.

connector.otherAccount.text: You have a connector on another account. A connector belongs to the {{product}} account it was added in, so the one you hand this work to needs its own.
connector.otherAccount.description: Text under the heading of the connector setup card when the person already connected a different account. {{product}} is Claude or ChatGPT.

connector.intro.text: {{product}} reads your apps, mints the work order and opens the proposal through this connector. It takes a few minutes, once per account.
connector.intro.description: Text under the heading of the connector setup card. {{product}} is Claude or ChatGPT. A work order is the brief Homeroom hands that agent; the proposal is the change put up for the group's vote.

connector.startNewChatgpt.text: Then start a NEW ChatGPT chat. A connector you just added is only picked up by a new one, so the chat you were already in will not see it.
connector.startNewChatgpt.description: Note under the setup steps in the connector setup card, for ChatGPT. NEW is in capitals for emphasis.

connector.startNewClaude.text: Then start a NEW Claude conversation. A connector you just added is only picked up by a new one, so the chat you were already in will not see it.
connector.startNewClaude.description: Note under the setup steps in the connector setup card, for Claude. NEW is in capitals for emphasis.

connector.done.description: Main button of the connector setup card: the person says they added the connector, and Homeroom checks whether it is connected now.

connector.moreSettings.description: Link at the bottom of the connector setup card: goes to the Connectors section of Settings.

ownTools.promptHelp.text: Copy this prompt into your agent. It includes this app and any work already started; fill in any remaining placeholders.
ownTools.promptHelp.description: Help line beside the ready-made prompt in the dev chat's guide for building with a coding tool on the person's own computer. 'Agent' is that coding tool.

ownTools.alreadyBuilt.text: Already built a pull request yourself?
ownTools.alreadyBuilt.description: Question under the guide for building with one's own tools in the dev chat, above the button that imports an existing pull request.

ownTools.import.description: Button under the own-tools guide in the dev chat: opens the dialog that turns an existing pull request into a proposal. PR is short for pull request.

header.venue.busyTitle.text: Wait for the current response to finish before changing where this session is built.
header.venue.busyTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled venue button at the top of a dev chat session while the coding agent is answering. The venue is where the change is built: on Homeroom, on the person's computer, or in another AI product.

header.venue.busyLabel.text: {{venue}}. Unavailable while the agent is thinking.
header.venue.busyLabel.description: Accessible name of the disabled venue button at the top of a dev chat session while the coding agent is working. {{venue}} is the current venue's name, for example 'Homeroom · Claude'.

header.venue.thinking.description: Small status beside a lock on the venue button at the top of a dev chat session while the coding agent is working.

header.mode.building.description: Label in the switch at the top of a dev chat session for the side where the person is working on the change in chat, as opposed to looking at its preview. Also the status chip shown when there is no preview yet.

header.mode.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the two-way switch at the top of a dev chat session: one side shows the preview of the change, the other the chat where it is built. Both words are verbs.

header.mode.previewLabel.description: Accessible name of the eye button in the switch at the top of a dev chat session, when a staging preview exists: shows it. 'Preview' is a verb.

header.mode.buildPreviewLabel.text: Build a preview of this change
header.mode.buildPreviewLabel.description: Accessible name of the eye button in the switch at the top of a dev chat session, when the preview has to be built first.

header.mode.previewTitle.description: Tooltip on the eye button at the top of a dev chat session when a preview exists. 'Staging' is the test copy of the app where a change runs before it is merged.

header.mode.buildPreviewTitle.text: Build a staging preview of this change (it went to sleep, or was never built)
header.mode.buildPreviewTitle.description: Tooltip on the eye button at the top of a dev chat session when the preview is not running: pressing it builds one. 'Went to sleep' means it was shut down after not being used.

header.mode.preview.description: Label on the lit side of the switch at the top of a dev chat session while the person is looking at the change's preview. A noun.

header.mode.backToBuilding.description: Accessible name of the pencil button in the switch at the top of a dev chat session: leaves the preview and returns to the chat where the change is built.

header.mode.backToChat.description: Tooltip on the pencil button in the switch at the top of a dev chat session: leaves the preview and returns to the chat.

header.actions.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the ⋯ button at the top of a dev chat session: opens a menu of things to do with the session, such as archiving it.

header.openCard.description: Link at the top of a dev chat session that has a pull request: goes to the page for this change's proposal. 'Open' is a verb.

header.newChange.description: Quiet label at the top of a dev chat session that has no pull request yet: this is a change that has not been built. 'Change' is a noun.

sessions.row.open.description: Accessible name of a row in the list of dev chat sessions; pressing the row opens that session. {{title}} is the session's title and {{status}} its state, a short word such as 'active'.

sessions.row.working.description: Small status on a row in the list of dev chat sessions while the coding agent is working in that session. Lower case.

sessions.row.pr.description: Link on a row in the list of dev chat sessions to the session's pull request on GitHub. PR is short for pull request; {{number}} is its number.

sessions.empty.title.text: Want to change this app? Just ask.
sessions.empty.title.description: Heading shown where the list of dev chat sessions would be, when the app has none yet.

sessions.empty.body.text: Describe what you'd like different in plain English. An AI writes the code and opens a real pull request. No coding required. The app’s users then vote it in.
sessions.empty.body.description: Explanation under the heading of the empty list of dev chat sessions. 'In plain English' means in everyday words rather than code; translate it as the equivalent idiom.

sessions.empty.howTo.text: Hit <0>+ New Session</0> above to start, e.g. <1>"make the header dark blue"</1>.
sessions.empty.howTo.description: Last line of the empty list of dev chat sessions. <0> wraps the name of the button above the list and <1> an example of what to ask for; keep both pairs of tags.

sessions.older.loading.description: Label of the last row of the list of dev chat sessions while older, finished sessions are being fetched.

sessions.older.show_one.description: Last row of the list of dev chat sessions: loads the finished sessions that were left out. {{number}} is how many there are, already formatted with digit separators.

sessions.older.show_other.description: Last row of the list of dev chat sessions: loads the finished sessions that were left out. {{number}} is how many there are, already formatted with digit separators.

spec.loading.description: Shown in the plan viewer beside the dev chat while the plan is being fetched. A plan is the written description of a change, made before it is built.

spec.tabs.label.description: Accessible name of the two tabs in the plan viewer that switch between the plan's user-facing and technical halves.

spec.tabs.user.description: Tab in the plan viewer: the half of the plan that describes what people using the app will see.

spec.tabs.technical.description: Tab in the plan viewer: the half of the plan that describes how the change will be implemented.

spec.tabs.empty.description: Shown in the plan viewer when the selected half of the plan has no content.

spec.copy.label.description: Button in the plan viewer's header: copies the whole plan to the clipboard as markdown text.

spec.copy.noneTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled 'Copy markdown' button in the plan viewer when there is no plan.

spec.copy.title.text: Copy the whole plan (both sections) as markdown
spec.copy.title.description: Tooltip on the 'Copy markdown' button in the plan viewer.

spec.copy.copied.description: Label the 'Copy markdown' button in the plan viewer shows for a moment after the plan was copied.

spec.copy.failed.description: Label the 'Copy markdown' button in the plan viewer shows for a moment when copying did not work.

spec.copy.failedToast.text: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it manually
spec.copy.failedToast.description: Toast when copying the plan in the plan viewer to the clipboard did not work.

spec.share.noneTitle.text: No plan version to share yet
spec.share.noneTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled share buttons in the plan viewer when no version of the plan exists.

spec.share.toGroup.description: Button in the plan viewer's header: posts a card linking to this plan in the app's group chat. 'Share' is a verb.

spec.share.groupSharedTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled 'Shared' button in the plan viewer once this plan version was posted to the group chat.

spec.share.groupTitle.text: Post a card linking to this plan in the group chat
spec.share.groupTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Share to group' button in the plan viewer. 'Post' is a verb.

spec.share.shared.description: Label of the disabled group-share button in the plan viewer once this plan version was posted to the group chat.

spec.share.toUser.description: Button in the plan viewer's header: opens a small card for sending this plan version privately to one person. 'Share' is a verb.

spec.share.userTitle.text: Privately share this plan version with one person
spec.share.userTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Share to user' button in the plan viewer.

spec.share.sentTo.description: Label the 'Share to user' button in the plan viewer shows for a moment after the plan was sent. {{username}} is the recipient's username; keep the @ before it.

spec.share.enterUsername.description: Error in the plan viewer's share card when Send was pressed with the username box empty.

spec.share.failed.description: Error in the plan viewer's share card when sending the plan to a person failed and the server gave no reason.

spec.share.dialogLabel.text: Share this plan with one person
spec.share.dialogLabel.description: Accessible name of the small card in the plan viewer for sending the plan privately to one person.

spec.share.usernamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box in the plan viewer's share card where the recipient's username is typed.

spec.share.usernameLabel.description: Accessible name of the box in the plan viewer's share card where the recipient's username is typed.

spec.share.sending.description: Label of the Send button in the plan viewer's share card while the plan is being sent.

spec.share.send.description: Button in the plan viewer's share card: sends this plan version to the person whose username was typed.

spec.noVersions.description: Only option of the disabled version dropdown in the plan viewer when the plan has no saved versions.

spec.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the plan viewer beside the dev chat.

spec.buildHint.text: This is a plan, not a built change. Ready? Ask the AI in chat to build it.
spec.buildHint.description: Line at the bottom of the plan viewer while the change has only been planned: nothing was built yet.

view.checks.description: Heading, and accessible name, of the collapsible section in a dev chat session that lists the automated checks run on the proposed change. 'Proposal' is the change put up for a vote.

view.proposalHint.text: Describe the change you want. When it’s ready, promoting this session's PR is what creates the proposal everyone votes on.
view.proposalHint.description: One-time hint above a dev chat session opened to make a proposal. PR is short for pull request; 'promoting' it means submitting it for the group's vote.

view.returnHint.label.description: Accessible name of the hint box in a dev chat session that says the person can leave and come back. 'Dev chat' is the chat with the coding agent.

view.returnHint.title.description: Heading of the hint box in a dev chat session that says the work continues while the person is away.

view.returnHint.body.text: You can leave this page and return anytime. Open <0>Messages</0> to check your change’s status or find this chat again.
view.returnHint.body.description: Body of the hint box in a dev chat session. <0> wraps the name of the Messages tab; keep the tags and use the tab's name as it is translated in the tab bar.

view.returnHint.dismiss.description: Button on the hint box in a dev chat session: dismisses the hint.

view.resizeSpec.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the dev chat and the plan viewer.

view.resizeStaging.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the dev chat and the docked staging preview.

transcript.forceStop.description: Button on a status line in the dev chat transcript when the coding agent did not stop after Stop was pressed: ends the agent's request immediately.

transcript.progress.steps_one.description: Chip on the coding agent's progress card in the dev chat: how many steps (tool actions) the agent has taken so far in this request. {{count}} is that number.

transcript.progress.steps_other.description: Chip on the coding agent's progress card in the dev chat: how many steps (tool actions) the agent has taken so far in this request. {{count}} is that number.

transcript.progress.guessTitle.text: Experimental: a small AI model's rough guess from the progress log. May be wrong.
transcript.progress.guessTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'AI guess' line of the coding agent's progress card in the dev chat.

transcript.progress.guess.description: Line on the coding agent's progress card in the dev chat. {{estimate}} is a model's own rough words for how much longer the work will take, for example 'about 3 minutes'. Keep the ✦ first.

transcript.spec.open.description: Accessible name of the plan preview card in the dev chat transcript; pressing the card opens the full plan beside the chat. 'Open' is a verb.

transcript.spec.viewFull.description: Call to action at the top right of the plan preview card in the dev chat transcript. Keep the arrow last.

transcript.issueDraft.showFull.description: Cue at the end of the shortened text on the card where the coding agent suggests filing a report; pressing it expands the whole text. Keep the leading ellipsis.

transcript.issueDraft.dismiss.description: Button on the card in the dev chat where the coding agent suggests filing an issue or a report: declines the suggestion.

card.changes.openVote.description: Tooltip on the status badge of the changes card in the dev chat once the change is up for a vote: pressing it goes to the page where the group votes on it.

card.changes.previewGone.text: Preview removed after merge. This change is now live in the app
card.changes.previewGone.description: Tooltip on the disabled 'Preview staging' and 'Test this change' buttons of the changes card in the dev chat after the change was merged.

card.changes.prLink.description: Link at the top of the changes card in the dev chat to the pull request on GitHub. PR is short for pull request; {{number}} is its number.

card.changes.ready.description: Heading of the changes card in the dev chat when it does not show a pull request link: the coding agent finished building the change.

card.changes.openRequest.description: Tooltip on a chip of the changes card in the dev chat that names a request this change answers: pressing it opens that request. 'Open' is a verb; a request is something a member asked for. {{number}} is the request's number.

card.changes.closes.description: Chip on the changes card in the dev chat: merging this change will close the request with that number. {{number}} is the request's number.

card.changes.closed.description: Chip on the changes card in the dev chat after the change was merged: it closed the request with that number. {{number}} is the request's number.

card.changes.previewStaging.description: Button on the changes card in the dev chat: opens the staging preview, the test copy of the app running this change. 'Preview' is a verb.

card.changes.test.description: Button on the changes card in the dev chat: opens the staging preview with the coding agent's instructions for trying the change.

card.changes.viewOnGithub.description: Link on the changes card in the dev chat: opens the change's pull request on GitHub.

card.changes.proposing.description: Label beside a spinner on the changes card's main button in the dev chat while the change is being submitted for the group's vote.

card.changes.alreadyProposed.description: Label of the disabled main button on the changes card in the dev chat once the change was submitted for the group's vote.

card.changes.submit.description: Main button on the changes card in the dev chat: puts the change up for the group's vote.

card.changes.mergedTitle.text: This change is merged and now live in the app.
card.changes.mergedTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Merged' badge of the changes card in the dev chat.

card.changes.mergedBadge.text: ✓ Merged, now live in the app
card.changes.mergedBadge.description: Badge on the changes card in the dev chat once the change was merged. Keep the check mark first.

card.changes.mergedNote.text: Merged, now live in the app
card.changes.mergedNote.description: Note on a changes card in the dev chat that shows no buttons, once the change was merged.

card.changes.earlierResult.description: Note on an older changes card in the dev chat transcript: a newer build of the change followed it, so this card has no buttons. 'Build' is a noun.

card.changes.resultNote.text: Build result. Current actions are above.
card.changes.resultNote.description: Note on a changes card shown inside another page: it reports the result of building the change, and the buttons for it are higher on that page. 'Build' is a noun.

transcript.who.you.description: Screen-reader label on the person's own messages in the dev chat transcript.

transcript.who.claudeCode.description: Label on the coding agent's messages in the dev chat transcript. Claude Code is the agent's product name and is not translated.

transcript.who.ai.description: Label on the assistant's messages in the dev chat transcript. Short for artificial intelligence.

transcript.fullOutput.description: Toggle under a message from the coding agent in the dev chat: expands the agent's complete output for that reply.

transcript.attachment.openFullSize.description: Tooltip on an image attached to a dev chat message. {{name}} is the file's name; pressing the image opens it at full size.

transcript.attachment.openFullSizeUnname.description: Tooltip on an image attached to a dev chat message. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

transcript.attachment.download.description: Tooltip on a file attached to a dev chat message. {{name}} is the file's name.

transcript.attachment.downloadUnnamed.description: Tooltip on a file attached to a dev chat message. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

transcript.reasoning.description: Toggle under a message in the dev chat: expands the coding agent's unedited reasoning text for that reply.

transcript.qa.less.description: Accessible name of the − button beside a number the coding agent asked for in the dev chat: lowers the number.

transcript.qa.more.description: Accessible name of the + button beside a number the coding agent asked for in the dev chat: raises the number.

transcript.qa.value.description: Accessible name of the number box in a question from the coding agent in the dev chat, when the question has no label of its own.

transcript.qa.suggested.description: Small hint inside an answer chip under a question from the coding agent: this answer is the one the agent recommends. Lower case, it follows the answer's text.

transcript.qa.send.description: Button under a set of questions from the coding agent in the dev chat: sends the answers the person picked.

transcript.qa.useDefaults.description: Button under a set of questions from the coding agent in the dev chat: answers every question with the agent's recommended choice.

transcript.emptyTitle.description: Heading in the middle of a new, empty dev chat session, where the conversation will appear.

transcript.qa.suggestedNumber.description: Hint beside the number box in a question from the coding agent: the value the agent recommends. {{number}} is that value. Lower case.

list.dot.description: How two independent facts are shown side by side in the dev chat's compact labels, for example a model's name and its cost: 'Opus 5.5 · about $1.55 for a typical change'. {{first}} and {{second}} are the two facts, each already a whole label. Change only the separator if the language needs another.

composer.placeholder.text: Describe a change in plain English, e.g. "add a dark mode toggle". No coding needed.
composer.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the dev chat message box. 'In plain English' means in everyday words rather than code; translate it as the equivalent idiom. The quoted text is an example request.

composer.placeholderBusy.text: {{agent}} is working. Type your next note and tap 💾 to save it for later.
composer.placeholderBusy.description: Placeholder in the dev chat message box while the coding agent is working on a request. {{agent}} is the agent's name, Claude or OpenRouter. Keep the 💾, which stands for the save-draft button.

model.cost.perChange.description: Cost note beside a model's name in the dev chat's model dropdown. {{amount}} is an estimated price with its currency sign, for example $1.55. Lower case: it follows the model's name after a dot.

model.cost.perChangeEstimate.description: Longer form of a model's cost note in the dev chat, which says outright that the figure is an estimate. {{amount}} is a price with its currency sign, for example $1.55. Lower case: it follows the model's name.

model.option.openRouterKeyTitle.description: Tooltip on a model in the dev chat's model dropdown: using this model is billed to the person's own OpenRouter API key. 'Runs' is a verb.

model.option.claudeKeyTitle.text: Runs on the platform Claude allowance, or your own Anthropic key
model.option.claudeKeyTitle.description: Tooltip on a Claude model in the dev chat's model dropdown: it is paid from Homeroom's included allowance or from the person's own Anthropic API key. 'Runs' is a verb.

model.option.addMore.description: Last row of the dev chat's model dropdown: opens a dialog for choosing from every model on OpenRouter.

model.option.addMoreTitle.text: Browse every model your OpenRouter key can reach
model.option.addMoreTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Add more OpenRouter models…' row of the dev chat's model dropdown.

model.option.loading.description: Disabled row in the dev chat's model dropdown shown while the session's chosen model is still being looked up.

model.option.label.description: A row in the list of OpenRouter models in the dialog that chooses where a session is built. {{model}} is the model's name with its badges, and {{facts}} its price and how well it is verified. Change only the punctuation between them if needed.

model.unknown.description: Shown in place of a model's name in the list of OpenRouter models when the model has no name.

model.badge.recommended.description: Badge after a model's name in the list of OpenRouter models: Homeroom recommends this model.

model.badge.new.description: Badge after a model's name in the list of OpenRouter models: the model was released in the last 30 days.

model.compatibility.verified.description: Short tag at the end of a row in the list of OpenRouter models: the model has been checked to work for coding in a repository. Lower case.

model.compatibility.limited.description: Short tag at the end of a row in the list of OpenRouter models: the model may lack what coding in a repository needs. Lower case.

model.compatibility.unverified.description: Short tag at the end of a row in the list of OpenRouter models: the model has not been checked for coding in a repository. Lower case.

model.compatibility.verifiedNote.description: Sentence under the model list in the dialog that chooses where a session is built: the selected model has been checked to work for coding in a repository.

model.compatibility.unverifiedNote.text: OpenRouter advertises coding-tool support and enough context, but this model is not yet verified for repository coding.
model.compatibility.unverifiedNote.description: Sentence under the model list in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, for a model that should work but has not been checked. 'Context' is how much text the model can take in at once.

model.compatibility.limitedNote.text: OpenRouter exposes this model, but it may lack repository tools or enough context; the turn may fail.
model.compatibility.limitedNote.description: Sentence under the model list in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, for a model that may not be able to do the work. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent.

model.tier.free.description: Price level of an OpenRouter model in the dialog that chooses where a session is built: the model costs nothing.

model.tier.low.description: Price level of an OpenRouter model in the dialog that chooses where a session is built.

model.tier.medium.description: Price level of an OpenRouter model in the dialog that chooses where a session is built.

model.tier.high.description: Price level of an OpenRouter model in the dialog that chooses where a session is built.

model.tier.unknown.description: Shown in place of a price level for an OpenRouter model whose price is not known.

model.cost.summary.description: Price summary of an OpenRouter model in the dialog that chooses where a session is built. {{tier}} is the price level, for example 'Low cost'. {{inputPrice}} and {{outputPrice}} are prices with their currency sign per million tokens ('/M') of text sent to the model and written by it, or a question mark when unknown.

model.catalog.updatedNow.description: Note under the list of OpenRouter models: the list was refreshed less than a minute ago.

model.catalog.updatedMinutes_one.description: Note under the list of OpenRouter models: how long ago the list was refreshed. {{count}} is a number of minutes; 'm' is short for minutes.

model.catalog.updatedMinutes_other.description: Note under the list of OpenRouter models: how long ago the list was refreshed. {{count}} is a number of minutes; 'm' is short for minutes.

model.catalog.updatedHours_one.description: Note under the list of OpenRouter models: how long ago the list was refreshed. {{count}} is a number of hours; 'h' is short for hours.

model.catalog.updatedHours_other.description: Note under the list of OpenRouter models: how long ago the list was refreshed. {{count}} is a number of hours; 'h' is short for hours.

transcript.agentRunning.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript while the coding agent works. {{tail}} is whatever punctuation followed the server's own sentence, usually three dots or nothing; keep it directly after the last word.

agentChoice.error.favorite.description: Error under the model list in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, when starring or unstarring a model failed and the server gave no reason.

agentChoice.error.loadSettings.text: Could not load your coding-agent settings.
agentChoice.error.loadSettings.description: Error in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, when the person's saved choice of coding agent could not be fetched.

agentChoice.error.loadSettingsShort.description: Error in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, when the saved coding-agent settings could not be fetched and no other reason is known.

agentChoice.error.checkCredential.text: Could not check your OpenRouter credential.
agentChoice.error.checkCredential.description: Error when Homeroom could not find out whether the person has a working OpenRouter API key, and the server gave no reason.

agentChoice.error.provision.text: OpenRouter could not be set up automatically (HTTP {{status}}).
agentChoice.error.provision.description: Error when Homeroom tried to create an OpenRouter key for the person and failed. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code of the failed request.

agentChoice.error.notDefault.text: OpenRouter was created, but it was not saved as your default. Contact an administrator.
agentChoice.error.notDefault.description: Error when an OpenRouter key was created for the person but could not be made their default coding agent.

agentChoice.error.checkKey.text: Could not check your OpenRouter key.
agentChoice.error.checkKey.description: Error in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, when Homeroom could not find out whether the person's OpenRouter API key works.

agentChoice.error.loadModels.description: Error in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, when the list of OpenRouter models could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

agentChoice.error.noModels.text: No OpenRouter models are available right now. Try Refresh.
agentChoice.error.noModels.description: Message in the dialog that chooses where a session is built, when the list of OpenRouter models came back empty. Refresh is the name of the button beside the list.

agentChoice.title.model.description: Title of the dialog that picks which OpenRouter model a dev chat session uses.

agentChoice.title.switch.description: Title of the dialog that changes which coding agent an existing dev chat session uses. 'Build' is a verb: where the change gets built.

agentChoice.title.create.description: Title of the dialog that chooses which coding agent a new dev chat session uses. 'Build' is a verb: where the change gets built.

agentChoice.intro.model.text: Changing the model keeps this branch and conversation, but starts fresh OpenRouter context on the next turn.
agentChoice.intro.model.description: Text under the title of the dialog that picks an OpenRouter model. 'Context' is what the model remembers of the session; a 'turn' is one request to the coding agent.

agentChoice.intro.switch.text: Switching keeps this branch and conversation, but starts a fresh coding-agent context on the next turn.
agentChoice.intro.switch.description: Text under the title of the dialog that changes a session's coding agent. 'Context' is what the agent remembers of the session; a 'turn' is one request to it.

agentChoice.intro.create.text: Both agents stay available. Your saved default is preselected; this choice is pinned to the new session.
agentChoice.intro.create.description: Text under the title of the dialog that chooses the coding agent for a new dev chat session.

agentChoice.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the two choices in the coding-agent dialog (Homeroom · OpenRouter and Homeroom · Claude): which AI builds in this session.

agentChoice.openRouterBlurb.text: Preferred. Use your included credits or personal key, with any available model.
agentChoice.openRouterBlurb.description: Description under the 'Homeroom · OpenRouter' choice in the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.claudeBlurb.text: Use the platform Claude allowance instead.
agentChoice.claudeBlurb.description: Description under the 'Homeroom · Claude' choice in the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.savedDefault.description: Small badge on the choice in the coding-agent dialog that the person saved as their default.

agentChoice.modelLabel.description: Label over the model search box and list in the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.filterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the search box over the list of OpenRouter models in the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.favoritesOff.description: Toggle button beside the model search box in the coding-agent dialog while every model is listed: pressing it lists only starred models. Keep the hollow star first.

agentChoice.favoritesOn.description: Toggle button beside the model search box in the coding-agent dialog while only starred models are listed. Keep the filled star first.

agentChoice.refresh.description: Button beside the model search box in the coding-agent dialog: fetches the list of OpenRouter models again.

agentChoice.refreshing.description: Label of the Refresh button in the coding-agent dialog while the list of OpenRouter models is being fetched.

agentChoice.star.add.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the ☆ button beside the model list in the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.star.remove.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the ★ button beside the model list in the coding-agent dialog, when the selected model is already a favorite.

agentChoice.catalogNote.text: Platform recommendations start in Favorites. Clear the Favorites filter to browse the complete key-visible catalog. Rates are per 1M tokens; actual spend depends on usage.
agentChoice.catalogNote.description: Small print under the model list in the coding-agent dialog. Favorites is the name of the filter button. 'Key-visible catalog' means every model the person's OpenRouter key can use; '1M tokens' is one million tokens.

agentChoice.effort.label.description: Label of the dropdown in the coding-agent dialog that sets how much thinking the model does before it answers.

agentChoice.effort.default.description: Option in the 'Reasoning effort' dropdown of the coding-agent dialog: leave it to the model's own setting.

agentChoice.effort.minimal.description: Option in the 'Reasoning effort' dropdown of the coding-agent dialog: the least thinking.

agentChoice.effort.low.description: Option in the 'Reasoning effort' dropdown of the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.effort.medium.description: Option in the 'Reasoning effort' dropdown of the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.effort.high.description: Option in the 'Reasoning effort' dropdown of the coding-agent dialog.

agentChoice.effort.xhigh.description: Option in the 'Reasoning effort' dropdown of the coding-agent dialog: the most thinking.

agentChoice.openSettings.description: Button at the bottom of the coding-agent dialog: goes to the OpenRouter section of Settings. 'Open' is a verb.

agentChoice.catalog.count_one.description: Note under the model list in the coding-agent dialog: how many models the search shows out of all of them. {{shown}} is the number listed and {{count}} the total.

agentChoice.catalog.count_other.description: Note under the model list in the coding-agent dialog: how many models the search shows out of all of them. {{shown}} is the number listed and {{count}} the total.

agentChoice.catalog.noMatch.text: No models match. Clear the search or show all models
agentChoice.catalog.noMatch.description: Note under the model list in the coding-agent dialog when the search finds nothing. It has no full stop because the time the list was refreshed may follow it after a dot.

agentChoice.apply.model.description: Main button of the dialog that picks an OpenRouter model for a dev chat session.

agentChoice.apply.switch.description: Main button of the dialog that changes a session's coding agent. {{venue}} is the chosen one's name, 'Homeroom · OpenRouter' or 'Homeroom · Claude'.

agentChoice.apply.build.description: Main button of the dialog that chooses the coding agent for a new session. 'Build' is a verb. {{venue}} is the chosen one's name, 'Homeroom · OpenRouter' or 'Homeroom · Claude'.

agentChoice.apply.setUp.description: Main button of the coding-agent dialog when OpenRouter is chosen but the person has no OpenRouter API key yet: goes to where one is added.

agentChoice.status.claudeAfterError.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog when the settings failed to load and 'Homeroom · Claude' is selected. {{error}} is a whole sentence saying what went wrong. 'Homeroom · Claude' is a name and is not translated.

agentChoice.status.claude.text: Homeroom · Claude builds in this chat on your daily Homeroom credits.
agentChoice.status.claude.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog while 'Homeroom · Claude' is selected. 'Homeroom · Claude' is a name and is not translated; 'builds' is a verb.

agentChoice.status.openRouterDisabled.text: Homeroom · OpenRouter is not enabled for this account or deployment.
agentChoice.status.openRouterDisabled.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog when OpenRouter cannot be chosen. 'Homeroom · OpenRouter' is a name and is not translated.

agentChoice.status.addKey.text: Add your OpenRouter API key before choosing OpenRouter.
agentChoice.status.addKey.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog when OpenRouter is selected and the person has no OpenRouter API key.

agentChoice.status.noMatch.text: No models match. Clear the search or show all models.
agentChoice.status.noMatch.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog when the search over OpenRouter models finds nothing.

agentChoice.status.model.text: {{cost}}. {{compatibility}} This session bills directly to your OpenRouter key.
agentChoice.status.model.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog describing the selected OpenRouter model. {{cost}} is its price summary, without a full stop, for example 'Low cost · $1 /M input · $5 /M output'. {{compatibility}} is a whole sentence about how well the model is verified.

agentChoice.status.modelNoEffort.text: {{cost}}. {{compatibility}} This model does not expose reasoning-effort controls. This session bills directly to your OpenRouter key.
agentChoice.status.modelNoEffort.description: Status line in the coding-agent dialog describing a selected OpenRouter model whose reasoning effort cannot be set. {{cost}} is its price summary, without a full stop. {{compatibility}} is a whole sentence about how well the model is verified.

agentChoice.error.refresh.description: Error in the coding-agent dialog when fetching the list of OpenRouter models again failed with no other reason.

agentSwitch.alreadySelected.text: {{venue}} is already selected for this session.
agentSwitch.alreadySelected.description: Toast when the person picks the coding agent the session already uses. {{venue}} is its name, 'Homeroom · OpenRouter' or 'Homeroom · Claude'.

agentSwitch.failed.description: Toast when changing a session's coding agent failed and the server gave no reason.

agentSwitch.nowUses.description: Toast after a session's coding agent was changed. {{venue}} is the new one's name, 'Homeroom · OpenRouter' or 'Homeroom · Claude'.

agentSwitch.networkError.text: Network error while switching coding agents.
agentSwitch.networkError.description: Toast when changing a session's coding agent failed because the server could not be reached.

agentSwitch.platformFailed.text: Could not switch to the platform agent.
agentSwitch.platformFailed.description: Toast when moving a session back to Homeroom's own coding agent failed and the server gave no reason.

runner.yourMachine.description: Stands where the name of the person's own computer is shown on its own above the dev chat message box, when the computer has no name: in the 'Last turn: …' chip and as the option in the 'Run on:' dropdown. Shown alone, as a label; lower case in English. The tooltips have unnamed wordings of their own.

runner.handBack.confirm.text:
Hand coding turns back to Homeroom?

{{machine}} stops receiving turns for this session. Anything it already committed stays on the branch.
runner.handBack.confirm.description: Confirmation before a dev chat session stops running the coding agent on the person's own computer. {{machine}} is that computer's name. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent. Keep the blank line after the question.

runner.handBack.confirmUnnamed.text:
Hand coding turns back to Homeroom?

your machine stops receiving turns for this session. Anything it already committed stays on the branch.
runner.handBack.confirmUnnamed.description: Confirmation before a dev chat session stops running the coding agent on the person's own computer, when that computer has no name. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent. Keep the blank line after the question.

runner.handBack.failed.text: Could not hand the session back. Try again in a moment.
runner.handBack.failed.description: Alert when stopping the coding agent on the person's own computer and returning the session to Homeroom failed.

model.guidanceTooltip.text: A suggestion, not a rule. Any model can attempt any change. Opus is the general coding pick; reach for Fable when design judgment matters or the coding is genuinely difficult. Both cost more per change than Sonnet.
model.guidanceTooltip.description: Tooltip explaining the guidance shown beside the models. Opus, Fable and Sonnet are model names and are not translated.

model.option.withHint.description: A model's row in a model list: {{model}} is the model's name and {{hint}} a short phrase from the server saying what size of change it suits. Change only the punctuation between them if needed.

model.option.bestFor.description: A sentence about a model. {{model}} is the model's name and {{guidance}} a phrase from the server, starting in lower case, saying what kind of change it suits.

budget.reset.daily.description: Sentence at the end of the tooltip on the dev chat's AI-credits meter: when the daily allowance starts again. "Resets" is a verb; its subject, the allowance, is left out. {{time}} is the time of day in the person's own clock and format, for example "9:00 AM".

budget.reset.weekly.description: Sentence at the end of the tooltip on the dev chat's AI-credits meter: when the weekly allowance starts again. "Resets" is a verb; its subject, the allowance, is left out. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM".

budget.reset.weeklyUtc.description: Sentence at the end of the tooltip on the dev chat's AI-credits meter when the weekly allowance starts again at midnight UTC on Monday. UTC is the time zone.

budget.reset.dailyUtc.description: Sentence at the end of the tooltip on the dev chat's AI-credits meter when the daily allowance starts again at midnight UTC. UTC is the time zone.

budget.window.thisWeek.description: Label that starts the tooltip on the dev chat's AI-credits meter when the allowance is counted per week, as in 'This week: $3.20 of your $50.00 …'.

budget.window.today.description: Label that starts the tooltip on the dev chat's AI-credits meter when the allowance is counted per day, as in 'Today: $3.20 of your $10.00 …'.

budget.pill.thisTurn.description: Part of the meter in the dev chat message box: what the coding agent's current request has cost so far. {{amount}} is a number with two decimals; the dollar sign is in the text. Lower case.

budget.pill.thisTurnEstimated.description: Part of the meter in the dev chat message box: an estimate of what the coding agent's current request has cost so far. {{amount}} is a number with two decimals; keep the ~ and the dollar sign. Lower case.

budget.pill.thisTurnTitle.openRouter.text: Estimated from the model’s OpenRouter list price and the tokens this turn used. OpenRouter’s own usage records determine billing.
budget.pill.thisTurnTitle.openRouter.description: Tooltip on the 'this turn' figure of the dev chat meter in a session that runs on OpenRouter. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent.

budget.pill.thisTurnTitle.estimated.text: Estimated token spend so far. Updates while Claude Code works; final usage determines billing.
budget.pill.thisTurnTitle.estimated.description: Tooltip on the 'this turn' figure of the dev chat meter while the coding agent, Claude Code, is still working.

budget.pill.thisTurnTitle.reported.text: Token spend reported by Claude Code for this turn.
budget.pill.thisTurnTitle.reported.description: Tooltip on the 'this turn' figure of the dev chat meter once the coding agent, Claude Code, has reported what the request cost.

budget.pill.lockedWithKeyTitle.text: Platform credits are locked until you connect GitHub or X. Your own Anthropic key remains available.
budget.pill.lockedWithKeyTitle.description: Tooltip on the dev chat meter when Homeroom's free AI credits are locked until the person verifies their account, and they have saved their own Anthropic API key. X is the social network.

budget.pill.lockedWithKey.description: The dev chat meter when Homeroom's free AI credits are locked and the person has their own API key. <0> is a link to where the account is verified, <1> the separator and <2> the key; {{last4}} is the key's last four characters. Keep all three pairs of tags. Lower case.

budget.pill.verify.description: The dev chat meter when Homeroom's free AI credits are locked: a link to where the account is verified, which unlocks ten dollars of credits a day. Lower case.

budget.pill.verifyTitle.text: Connect GitHub or X to unlock $10/day
budget.pill.verifyTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'verify account' link of the dev chat meter. X is the social network.

budget.pill.keyAvailable.description: The dev chat meter when Homeroom cannot tell whether the person may use free credits, and they have saved their own API key. Lower case.
