banner.credits.locked.lead.text: You’re out of this week’s free AI credits.
banner.credits.locked.lead.description: First sentence, in bold, of the banner at the top of a dev chat session when the free AI credits are spent and more are locked until the account is verified.

banner.credits.locked.tail.text: Verify your account to get more: add your phone number, or link GitHub and X.
banner.credits.locked.tail.description: Second sentence of the dev chat banner shown when free AI credits are spent and more are locked. X is the social network.

banner.credits.unavailable.lead.text: Credit eligibility could not be verified.
banner.credits.unavailable.lead.description: First sentence, in bold, of the banner at the top of a dev chat session when Homeroom could not tell whether the person may use free AI credits.

banner.credits.unavailable.tail.text: Try again shortly, or use your own API key or another build venue.
banner.credits.unavailable.tail.description: Second sentence of the dev chat banner shown when credit eligibility could not be checked. A 'build venue' is where the change is built: on Homeroom, on the person's computer, or in another AI product.

banner.credits.out.leadWeekly.text: You’ve used up this week’s free AI credits.
banner.credits.out.leadWeekly.description: First sentence, in bold, of the red banner at the top of a dev chat session when the person's weekly free AI credits are spent.

banner.credits.out.leadDaily.text: You’ve used up today’s free AI credits.
banner.credits.out.leadDaily.description: First sentence, in bold, of the red banner at the top of a dev chat session when the person's daily free AI credits are spent.

banner.credits.out.leadPlatform.text: The platform’s shared daily AI budget is used up.
banner.credits.out.leadPlatform.description: First sentence, in bold, of the red banner at the top of a dev chat session when the AI budget shared by everyone on Homeroom is spent for the day.

banner.credits.out.resetDaily.description: Second sentence of the red out-of-credits banner in the dev chat, for a daily allowance. 'Reset' is a verb: the credits are restored. {{time}} is the time of day in the person's own clock and format, for example "9:00 AM".

banner.credits.out.resetWeekly.description: Second sentence of the red out-of-credits banner in the dev chat, for a weekly allowance. 'Reset' is a verb: the credits are restored. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM".

banner.credits.out.resetWeeklyUtc.description: Second sentence of the red out-of-credits banner in the dev chat when weekly credits are restored at midnight UTC on Monday. 'Reset' is a verb.

banner.credits.out.resetDailyUtc.text: Free credits reset at midnight UTC.
banner.credits.out.resetDailyUtc.description: Second sentence of the red out-of-credits banner in the dev chat when daily credits are restored at midnight UTC. 'Reset' is a verb.

banner.credits.out.tailPlans.text: Or keep working right now on your own Claude or ChatGPT plan, with your own API key, or with a coding tool on your computer.
banner.credits.out.tailPlans.description: Last sentence of the red out-of-credits banner in the dev chat, when handing the work to the person's own Claude or ChatGPT subscription is offered.

banner.credits.out.tailKey.text: Or keep working right now with your own API key, a coding tool on your computer, or your Claude.ai / ChatGPT subscription.
banner.credits.out.tailKey.description: Last sentence of the red out-of-credits banner in the dev chat.

banner.credits.low.tail.text: Set up another way to keep building before it runs out mid-change.
banner.credits.low.tail.description: Last sentence of the amber banner in the dev chat warning that free AI credits are nearly spent. 'It' is the credit; 'mid-change' means while a change is being built.

venue.refusal.verify.text: Verify your account to get more: add your phone number, or link GitHub and X.
venue.refusal.verify.description: Reason shown under the 'build on Homeroom' row of the sheet that chooses where a session is built, when free AI credits are locked until the account is verified. X is the social network.

venue.refusal.platformOut.text: The platform’s shared daily AI budget is used up.
venue.refusal.platformOut.description: Reason shown under the 'build on Homeroom' row of the sheet that chooses where a session is built, when the AI budget shared by everyone on Homeroom is spent for the day.

venue.refusal.outWeekly.text: You’ve used up this week’s free AI credits.
venue.refusal.outWeekly.description: Reason shown under the 'build on Homeroom' row of the sheet that chooses where a session is built, when the person's weekly free AI credits are spent.

venue.refusal.outDaily.text: You’ve used up today’s free AI credits.
venue.refusal.outDaily.description: Reason shown under the 'build on Homeroom' row of the sheet that chooses where a session is built, when the person's daily free AI credits are spent.

flow.linkGithub.tab.text: Finish linking GitHub in the tab that just opened, then come back here.
flow.linkGithub.tab.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps after the person pressed the button that links their GitHub account in a new browser tab.

flow.linkGithub.browser.text: Finish linking GitHub in your browser, then come back to the app. Sign in with the same Homeroom account if asked.
flow.linkGithub.browser.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps, in the phone app, after the person pressed the button that links their GitHub account in the browser.

flow.instructions.none.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when 'copy instructions' was pressed before any instructions for the coding agent exist.

flow.instructions.copied.text: Instructions copied. Paste them into your agent, which will ask what you want to build.
flow.instructions.copied.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps after the instructions for the person's own coding agent were copied to the clipboard.

flow.instructions.copyFailed.text: Could not reach the clipboard. Open the instructions below and copy them by hand.
flow.instructions.copyFailed.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when copying the coding agent's instructions to the clipboard failed.

flow.prepare.needBrief.text: Say what to build first. The work order needs something to hand your agent.
flow.prepare.needBrief.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when a work order was asked for with the description box empty. A work order is the brief Homeroom hands the person's own coding agent.

flow.prepare.needBriefBelow.text: Describe the change in the message box below first. The work order needs something to hand your agent.
flow.prepare.needBriefBelow.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when a work order was asked for with nothing typed in the chat's message box. A work order is the brief Homeroom hands the person's own coding agent.

flow.prepare.failed.text: Could not prepare the work order.
flow.prepare.failed.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when creating the work order failed and the server gave no reason.

flow.prepare.reused.text: You already had a work order for this app, so this reuses it.
flow.prepare.reused.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps when an existing work order for the app was used instead of a new one.

flow.prepare.ready.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps after a work order was created.

flow.networkError.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when a request could not reach the server. {{detail}} is the browser's own short message about the failure.

flow.discard.none.text: No work order to put away.
flow.discard.none.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when 'put away' was pressed and there is no work order.

flow.discard.done.text: Work order put away. Say what you want to build instead.
flow.discard.done.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps after the work order was discarded.

flow.discard.failed.text: Could not put that work order away.
flow.discard.failed.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when discarding the work order failed and the server gave no reason.

flow.submit.none.text: No work order to submit yet.
flow.submit.none.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when 'submit' was pressed and there is no work order.

flow.submit.failed.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when submitting the branch the person's coding agent pushed failed and the server gave no reason.

flow.submit.opened.description: Toast after the branch from the person's own coding agent was turned into a proposal. PR is short for pull request; {{number}} is its number. 'Proposal' is the change put up for the group's vote.

flow.submit.openedUnnumbered.description: Toast after the branch from the person's own coding agent was turned into a proposal, in the rare case the pull request's number is not known. PR is short for pull request.

flow.update.none.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when 'submit update' was pressed and there is no proposal to update.

flow.update.failed.description: Error in the dev chat's hand-off steps when submitting new commits to an existing proposal failed and the server gave no reason.

flow.update.nothingNew.text: Nothing new to submit. This session is already on that commit.
flow.update.nothingNew.description: Notice in the dev chat's hand-off steps when an update was submitted but the branch has no new commits.

flow.update.landed.text: Update landed. Reopen this session to rebuild its preview and re-run its checks.
flow.update.landed.description: Toast after new commits were added to a proposal whose session is asleep.

flow.update.submittedVotesCleared_one.description: Toast after new commits were added to a proposal, which removed the votes already cast on it. {{count}} is how many votes were removed.

flow.update.submittedVotesCleared_other.description: Toast after new commits were added to a proposal, which removed the votes already cast on it. {{count}} is how many votes were removed.

flow.update.submitted.description: Toast after new commits were added to a proposal.

session.resumeFailed.text: Could not resume this session right now. Try again in a moment.
session.resumeFailed.description: Toast when waking a paused dev chat session failed and the server gave no reason.

send.openRouterFailed.description: Message shown in the dev chat transcript, as if from the assistant, when a request to an OpenRouter model could not begin. The ** marks make the first sentence bold: keep them. {{detail}} is a whole sentence saying why, or what to do.

send.pleaseTryAgain.description: Sentence after 'OpenRouter turn could not start.' in the dev chat transcript when the server gave no reason.

send.creditsResetFallback.description: Sentence on the out-of-credits card in the dev chat transcript when the server did not say when the credits come back. 'They' are the free AI credits; UTC is the time zone.

send.rateLimited.description: Message shown in the dev chat transcript, as if from the assistant, when the person sent too many requests. The ** marks make the first sentence bold: keep them. {{detail}} is a whole sentence saying why, or what to do.

send.tryAgainLater.description: Sentence after 'Rate limit reached.' in the dev chat transcript when the server gave no reason.

send.failed.description: Message shown in the dev chat transcript, as if from the assistant, when the person's message could not be sent. The ** marks make the lead bold: keep them. {{detail}} is the server's reason, or 'HTTP' and a status code.

send.streamError.description: Line added to the assistant's reply in the dev chat transcript when the reply broke off with an error. Keep the leading > and the ** marks, which format it as a bold quoted line. {{error}} is the server's error text.

title.thinking.description: Browser tab title while the coding agent is working in the open dev chat session. {{title}} is the page's own title, for example the app's name. Keep the emoji first so it shows in a narrow tab.

title.sessionDone.description: Browser tab title after the coding agent finished while the person was away. {{title}} is the page's own title, for example the app's name. Keep the emoji first so it shows in a narrow tab.

title.sessionStopped.description: Browser tab title after the coding agent's work stopped before finishing while the person was away. {{title}} is the page's own title, for example the app's name. Keep the emoji first so it shows in a narrow tab.

title.proposalReady.description: Browser tab title after Homeroom's bot finished building a proposal while the person was away. {{title}} is the page's own title, for example the app's name. Keep the emoji first so it shows in a narrow tab.

title.proposalFailed.description: Browser tab title after Homeroom's bot failed to build a proposal while the person was away. {{title}} is the page's own title, for example the app's name. Keep the emoji first so it shows in a narrow tab.

stop.stopping.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript after the person pressed Stop, while the coding agent is being stopped.

stop.stoppingSlow.text: Stopping the agent… (taking longer than usual)
stop.stoppingSlow.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript after the person pressed Stop, once stopping the coding agent has taken unusually long.

stop.otherStopping.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript when another member pressed Stop. {{username}} is that member's username; keep the @ before it.

stop.otherStoppingSlow.text: @{{username}} is stopping the agent… (taking longer than usual)
stop.otherStoppingSlow.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript when another member pressed Stop and stopping the coding agent has taken unusually long. {{username}} is that member's username; keep the @ before it.

stop.stuck.text: Still stopping. The agent isn’t responding.
stop.stuck.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript when the coding agent has not stopped after a long wait; a 'Force stop' button appears beside it.

stop.forcing.description: Label of the 'Force stop' button in the dev chat transcript after it was pressed, while the coding agent is being ended.

stop.wrapUp.text: Almost done. The wrap-up can’t be interrupted.
stop.wrapUp.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript when Stop was pressed while the coding agent was in its final step, which cannot be stopped.

stop.failed.text: Couldn’t stop the agent. Please try again.
stop.failed.description: Status line in the dev chat transcript when stopping the coding agent failed.

transcript.agentLog.description: Toggle in the dev chat transcript that expands the coding agent's raw log. {{agent}} is the agent's name, Claude Code or OpenRouter. 'Log' is a noun.

transcript.agentOutput.description: Heading of a card in the dev chat transcript holding what the coding agent reported at the end of its work. {{agent}} is the agent's name, Claude Code or OpenRouter.

transcript.changesReady.description: Status line above the changes card in the dev chat transcript: the coding agent finished building the change.

transcript.changesReadyChecks.description: Status line above the changes card in the dev chat transcript when the change was built but its automated checks failed.

transcript.replyCost.description: Small note after the model's name over an assistant reply in the dev chat: what that reply cost. {{amount}} is a number with three decimals; the dollar sign is in the text. Lower case.

transcript.replyCostEstimated.description: Small note after the model's name over an assistant reply in the dev chat: an estimate of what that reply cost. {{amount}} is a number with three decimals; keep the ~ and the dollar sign. Lower case.

transcript.took.description: Note at the end of a finished status line in the dev chat transcript: how long that step took. {{duration}} is a length of time already in words, for example '2m 5s'. Keep the brackets.

transcript.qa.typeNumber.description: Last chip under a question from the coding agent whose answers are numbers: opens a box to type a different number. Also the placeholder and accessible name of that box.

transcript.qa.somethingElse.description: Last chip under a question from the coding agent: opens a box to type an answer that is not among the chips. Also the placeholder and accessible name of that box.

transcript.spec.versionHeader_one.description: Title of the plan preview card in the dev chat transcript. {{version}} is the plan's version number ('v' stands for version) and {{count}} its length in lines. A plan is the written description of a change, made before it is built.

transcript.spec.versionHeader_other.description: Title of the plan preview card in the dev chat transcript. {{version}} is the plan's version number ('v' stands for version) and {{count}} its length in lines. A plan is the written description of a change, made before it is built.

transcript.spec.draftedHeader_one.description: Title of the plan preview card in the dev chat transcript when the plan has no version number yet. {{count}} is its length in lines.

transcript.spec.draftedHeader_other.description: Title of the plan preview card in the dev chat transcript when the plan has no version number yet. {{count}} is its length in lines.

transcript.noVisibleReply.description: Shown in italics in place of an assistant reply in the dev chat that had no text; the raw reasoning can be expanded under it.

transcript.stopLanding.nothingCommitted.description: Chip on the line in the dev chat transcript that reports where things stood when the coding agent was stopped: it had saved no work. Lower case.

transcript.stopLanding.changesCommitted.description: Chip on the stopped-agent line in the dev chat transcript: the agent's work was saved to the branch, how many commits is not known. Lower case.

transcript.stopLanding.countCommitted_on.description: Chip on the stopped-agent line in the dev chat transcript: how many commits the agent saved to the branch before it was stopped. {{count}} is that number. Lower case.

transcript.stopLanding.countCommitted_ot.description: Chip on the stopped-agent line in the dev chat transcript: how many commits the agent saved to the branch before it was stopped. {{count}} is that number. Lower case.

transcript.stopLanding.pushed.description: Chip on the stopped-agent line in the dev chat transcript: the saved work was uploaded to the repository. Lower case.

transcript.stopLanding.notPushed.description: Chip on the stopped-agent line in the dev chat transcript: the saved work was not uploaded to the repository. Lower case.

issueDraft.suggestion.text: The AI suggests reporting this to the platform
issueDraft.suggestion.description: Status line above the card in the dev chat where the coding agent proposes reporting a problem to Homeroom, when the server sent no line of its own.

issueDraft.failed.description: Toast when filing or dismissing the report the coding agent suggested failed and the server gave no reason.

issueDraft.networkError.description: Toast when filing or dismissing the report the coding agent suggested could not reach the server.

issueDraft.reportedLink.description: Link on the suggested-report card in the dev chat once the report was filed: opens the issue. {{number}} is the issue's number.

issueDraft.filedOnApp.description: Note on the suggested-issue card in the dev chat once the issue was filed in the app's own code repository.

issueDraft.reportedToPlatform.description: Note on the suggested-report card in the dev chat once the report was sent to Homeroom.

issueDraft.dismissed.description: Note on the suggested-report card in the dev chat once the person declined the suggestion.

issueDraft.fileIssue.description: Main button on the card in the dev chat where the coding agent suggests an issue for this app: files it. 'File' is a verb.

issueDraft.reportToPlatform.description: Main button on the card in the dev chat where the coding agent suggests reporting a problem to Homeroom: sends the report. 'Report' is a verb.

issueDraft.destApp.description: Small heading of the suggested-issue card in the dev chat: the draft is for the named app. {{app}} is the app's name.

issueDraft.destThisApp.description: Small heading of the suggested-issue card in the dev chat when the app's name is not known.

issueDraft.destPlatform.description: Small heading of the card in the dev chat where the coding agent suggests reporting a problem to Homeroom.

markdown.fallbackNotice.text: Rich text formatting is unavailable right now, so this is the raw markdown.
markdown.fallbackNotice.description: Notice over a message in the dev chat when the formatter could not load and the message is shown as plain markdown text.

markdown.viewImage.description: Accessible name of an image inside a dev chat message; pressing it opens the image at full size.

sessions.row.untitled.description: Stands in for a session's title in the list of dev chat sessions when the session has no title, pull request or branch yet. A noun: one working session with the coding agent.

header.untitled.description: Stands in for the title at the top of an open dev chat session that has no title, pull request or branch yet. A noun: one working session with the coding agent.

sessions.action.free.description: Action on a dev chat session whose change is up for a vote: shuts down the AI worker that is still running for it. 'Free' is a verb.

sessions.action.freeing.description: Label of the 'Free worker' action on a dev chat session while the worker is being shut down.

sessions.action.freeTitle.text: Frees the AI worker. The PR stays up for voting.
sessions.action.freeTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Free worker' action of a dev chat session. PR is short for pull request.

sessions.action.unarchive.description: Action on an archived dev chat session: restores it. A verb.

sessions.action.unarchiveTitle.description: Tooltip on the Unarchive action of a dev chat session. PR is short for pull request.

sessions.action.archive.description: Action on a dev chat session: puts the session away and closes its pull request. A verb.

sessions.action.archiveTitle.text: Archive (frees the slot; restorable for a while)
sessions.action.archiveTitle.description: Tooltip on the Archive action of a dev chat session. A 'slot' is one of the limited number of sessions a person may have open.

sessions.toast.pauseFailed.description: Toast when pausing a dev chat session, or freeing its worker, failed and the server gave no reason.

sessions.toast.resumeFailed.description: Toast when resuming a paused dev chat session failed and the server gave no reason.

sessions.toast.workerFreed.description: Toast after the AI worker of a dev chat session was shut down.

sessions.archive.confirmTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before a dev chat session is archived. {{title}} is the session's title; keep the quotation marks around it. 'Archive' is a verb.

sessions.archive.confirmTitleUnnamed.description: Title of the confirmation before a dev chat session is archived, when the session has no title. 'Archive' is a verb.

sessions.archive.confirmBody.text: This closes the PR and frees the slot. You can Unarchive it later to restore it (chat memory is kept for 30 days).
sessions.archive.confirmBody.description: Body of the confirmation before a dev chat session is archived. Unarchive is the name of the action that restores it. PR is short for pull request; a 'slot' is one of the limited number of open sessions.

sessions.archive.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that archives a dev chat session. A verb.

sessions.toast.archiveFailed.description: Toast when archiving a dev chat session failed and the server gave no reason.

sessions.toast.unarchiveFailed.description: Toast when restoring an archived dev chat session failed and the server gave no reason.

sessions.restored.title.description: Title of the notice after an archived dev chat session was restored but the coding agent's memory of it was gone.

sessions.restored.body.text: Claude's memory had already been cleared, so this picks up as a fresh chat on the same branch.
sessions.restored.body.description: Body of the notice after an archived dev chat session was restored without the coding agent's memory. Claude is the agent's name.

banner.sync.phase.resolving.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner while the coding agent, Claude, resolves conflicts between the session's branch and main.

banner.sync.phase.pushing.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner while the merged branch is uploaded to the repository.

banner.sync.phase.syncing.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner while the session's branch is being brought up to date with the app's main branch. 'main' is the branch's name.

banner.sync.done.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner after the session's branch was brought up to date. 'main' is the branch's name.

banner.sync.failed.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner when bringing the session's branch up to date failed and no reason is known. 'main' is the branch's name.

banner.sync.failedHttp.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner when the sync request failed and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code.

banner.sync.failedDetail.description: Text of the dev chat's sync banner when the sync request could not reach the server. {{detail}} is the browser's own short message about the failure.

header.venue.title.text: Building in {{venue}}. {{blurb}} Pick a different venue: on Homeroom, on your computer, or handed to Claude Code or Codex on the web.
header.venue.title.description: Tooltip on the venue button at the top of a dev chat session. {{venue}} is the name of where the change is being built, and {{blurb}} a whole sentence describing that venue. Claude Code and Codex are product names.

header.openCardTitle.text: Open this change's proposal card (PR #{{number}}). Every change in this chat goes to PR #{{number}}. Use “Start a new change” for separate work.
header.openCardTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Open proposal card' link at the top of a dev chat session. {{number}} is the pull request's number, used twice. “Start a new change” is the name of a button: translate it as that button is translated.

header.newChangeTitle.text: This chat is one change → one pull request. A PR opens after the first build.
header.newChangeTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'New change' label at the top of a dev chat session that has no pull request yet. PR is short for pull request; 'build' is a noun.

composer.busy.working.description: Accessible name of the spinning round button in the dev chat message box while the coding agent's request is running and cannot be stopped from this screen.

composer.busy.finishing.description: Accessible name of the spinning round button in the dev chat message box while the coding agent's request is in its last step.

composer.busy.workingTitle.text: This turn is still running but can’t be stopped from here
composer.busy.workingTitle.description: Tooltip on the spinning round button in the dev chat message box. A 'turn' is one request to the coding agent.

composer.busy.finishingTitle.description: Tooltip on the spinning round button in the dev chat message box while the coding agent's request is in its last step.

attach.stillUploading.description: Error line under the dev chat message box when Send was pressed while an attached file is still uploading.

attach.tooBig.image.text: "{{name}}" is too big. Images max {{megabytes}} MB.
attach.tooBig.image.description: Error under the dev chat message box when an attached image is over the size limit. {{name}} is the file's name, kept in quotation marks, and {{megabytes}} the limit in megabytes.

attach.tooBig.zip.text: "{{name}}" is too big. Zip archives max {{megabytes}} MB.
attach.tooBig.zip.description: Error under the dev chat message box when an attached zip archive is over the size limit. {{name}} is the file's name, kept in quotation marks, and {{megabytes}} the limit in megabytes.

attach.tooBig.file.text: "{{name}}" is too big. Files max {{megabytes}} MB.
attach.tooBig.file.description: Error under the dev chat message box when an attached file is over the size limit. {{name}} is the file's name, kept in quotation marks, and {{megabytes}} the limit in megabytes.

attach.tooMany_one.description: Error under the dev chat message box when more files were attached than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

attach.tooMany_other.description: Error under the dev chat message box when more files were attached than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

attach.uploadFailedHttp.description: Error under the dev chat message box when uploading an attached file failed and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code.

attach.uploadFailed.description: Error under the dev chat message box when uploading an attached file failed and nothing more is known.

attach.zipBadge_one.description: Small badge on a zip archive attached to a dev chat message. {{files}} is how many files the archive holds. ZIP is the file type and stays in capitals.

attach.zipBadge_other.description: Small badge on a zip archive attached to a dev chat message. {{files}} is how many files the archive holds. ZIP is the file type and stays in capitals.

attach.unnamedFile.description: Stands where a file's name would be on an attachment that has none, in the dev chat's message box and transcript. Shown alone. A noun, lower case.

drafts.toast.dropped_one.text: That's {{limit}} saved drafts. {{count}} newer draft was dropped. Send or delete one first.
drafts.toast.dropped_one.description: Toast when drafts saved on another device could not all be kept because the list is full. {{limit}} is the most drafts a session may hold and {{count}} how many were left out.

drafts.toast.dropped_other.text: That's {{limit}} saved drafts. {{count}} newer drafts were dropped. Send or delete one first.
drafts.toast.dropped_other.description: Toast when drafts saved on another device could not all be kept because the list is full. {{limit}} is the most drafts a session may hold and {{count}} how many were left out.

drafts.toast.full.text: That's {{limit}} saved drafts. Send or delete one first
drafts.toast.full.description: Toast when the person tries to save another draft in the dev chat and the list is full. {{limit}} is the most drafts a session may hold.

drafts.toast.saved.text: Draft saved. Send it whenever you're ready
drafts.toast.saved.description: Toast after the text in the dev chat message box was saved as a draft.

drafts.toast.busy.text: Claude is still working. This will send once the turn finishes
drafts.toast.busy.description: Toast when the person tries to send a saved draft while the coding agent, Claude, is working. A 'turn' is one request to the agent.

drafts.toast.uploading.text: Still uploading a file, one moment…
drafts.toast.uploading.description: Toast when the person tries to send a saved draft while an attached file is still uploading.

drafts.toast.keptTyped.text: Kept what you had typed as another draft
drafts.toast.keptTyped.description: Toast when a saved draft was sent or put back into the message box while the box held other text: that text was saved as a draft of its own.

drafts.toast.deleted.description: Toast after a saved draft in the dev chat was deleted.

spec.version.label.description: An option in the plan viewer's version dropdown. 'v' stands for version; {{version}} is the version number.

spec.version.latest.description: The option for the newest version in the plan viewer's version dropdown. 'v' stands for version; {{version}} is the version number.

spec.version.pr.description: Part of an option in the plan viewer's version dropdown: the pull request that version was built into. PR is short for pull request; {{number}} is its number.

spec.empty.owner.text: No plan yet. Ask the AI to draft one.
spec.empty.owner.description: Shown in the plan viewer to the session's owner when no plan, the written description of the change, exists yet. 'The AI' is the coding agent in the dev chat.

spec.empty.viewer.text: No plan has been shared for this session yet.
spec.empty.viewer.description: Shown in the plan viewer to someone other than the session's owner when no plan exists yet.

spec.share.noSession.description: Error in the plan viewer's share card when there is no open session to share a plan from.

spec.share.networkError.description: Error in the plan viewer's share card when the share request could not reach the server.

launchpad.resume.continueTitle.description: Title of the note above the hand-off instructions in the dev chat when the session already has work on a branch: the person's own coding agent will continue it.

launchpad.resume.continueDetail.text: There is work on <0>{{branch}}</0> already. The instructions below tell your agent to start from its current commit, so nothing done here is lost. Copy them as they are: an agent that starts from the app’s default branch instead would rebuild this from scratch.
launchpad.resume.continueDetail.description: Body of the note above the hand-off instructions in the dev chat when the session already has work. {{branch}} is the git branch's name, shown as code: keep the <0> tags around it. 'Agent' is the person's own coding tool.

launchpad.resume.newTitle.description: Title of the note above the hand-off instructions in the dev chat when nothing has been built in the session yet.

launchpad.resume.newDetail.text: Nothing has been built in this session yet, so there is nothing to resume. Your agent starts from the app’s current code, implements and tests the change locally, then submits the result to Homeroom.
launchpad.resume.newDetail.description: Body of the note above the hand-off instructions in the dev chat when nothing has been built in the session yet. 'Agent' is the person's own coding tool.

commentPin.error.imageType.text: Only PNG and JPEG images can be attached.
commentPin.error.imageType.description: Error in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the person added a file that is not a PNG or JPEG image. PNG and JPEG are image formats; keep them.

commentPin.error.imageLimit_one.description: Error in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the person tried to add an image but the request already holds as many pictures as it can. {{count}} is that limit.

commentPin.error.imageLimit_other.description: Error in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the person tried to add an image but the request already holds as many pictures as it can. {{count}} is that limit.

commentPin.toast.postedMany_one.description: Toast after a request of several comments written in comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot, posted as a request to improve the app or Homeroom) was posted. {{count}} is how many comments it held (always more than one in English); {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom.

commentPin.toast.postedMany_other.description: Toast after a request of several comments written in comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot, posted as a request to improve the app or Homeroom) was posted. {{count}} is how many comments it held; {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom.

commentPin.toast.postedManyBuilding_one.text: Posted {{count}} comment to {{place}}. Homeroom bot is building it.
commentPin.toast.postedManyBuilding_one.description: Toast after a request of several comments written in comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot, posted as a request to improve the app or Homeroom) was posted and Homeroom's bot started building it. {{count}} is how many comments it held (always more than one in English); {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom. 'Homeroom bot' is the name of the platform's coding agent.

commentPin.toast.postedManyBuilding_othe.text: Posted {{count}} comments to {{place}}. Homeroom bot is building it.
commentPin.toast.postedManyBuilding_othe.description: Toast after a request of several comments written in comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot, posted as a request to improve the app or Homeroom) was posted and Homeroom's bot started building it. {{count}} is how many comments it held; {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom. 'Homeroom bot' is the name of the platform's coding agent.

commentPin.toast.kudosPlaced.text: Your kudos goes to whoever solves it.
commentPin.toast.kudosPlaced.description: Sentence said after the toast that a request from comment mode was posted, when the person put a kudos on it: the kudos will reward whoever solves the request.

commentPin.toast.kudosFailed.description: Sentence said after the toast that a request from comment mode was posted, when the kudos the person put on it was refused. {{reason}} is the server's own explanation, a clause without a final full stop.

commentPin.toast.kudosFailedNoReason.text: The kudos wasn't added: it could not be placed.
commentPin.toast.kudosFailedNoReason.description: Sentence said after the toast that a request from comment mode was posted, when the kudos the person put on it was refused without an explanation.

commentPin.toast.sentences.description: How two whole sentences are joined in the toast after a request from comment mode was posted, for example "Posted to Run Club. Thanks! Your kudos goes to whoever solves it." {{first}} is the sentence about where it was posted and {{second}} the one about the kudos. Only what goes between them is translated.

commentPin.posted.place.description: Header of the card of a request already posted from comment mode, opened from its marker on the page; also part of that marker's accessible name. {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom.

commentPin.posted.placeNumbered.description: Header of the card of a request already posted from comment mode, opened from its marker on the page; also part of that marker's accessible name. {{number}} is the request's number (keep the # before it); {{place}} is where it went: the app's name, or Homeroom. Keep the middle dot.

commentPin.hint.taking.description: Hint on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) while a new picture of the page is being taken; taps wait until it is ready.

commentPin.hint.next.text: Click where the next comment goes
commentPin.hint.next.description: Hint on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) after the person chose to add another comment to the same request: their next click places it.

commentPin.hint.writing.text: Enter posts it. Esc discards it.
commentPin.hint.writing.description: Hint on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) while a comment is being written. Enter and Esc are keyboard keys; "it" is the request.

commentPin.hint.carry.description: Hint on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) when the person switched from the form with words already written: their first click places those words on the page.

commentPin.hint.another.description: Hint on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) after at least one request was posted: a click leaves another comment.

commentPin.hint.start.text: Tap anywhere to suggest an improvement
commentPin.hint.start.description: Hint on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) when it opens: tapping or clicking anywhere on the page starts a suggestion there.

commentPin.kudos.cost.description: Tooltip of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), and said to screen readers after it, when the person's remaining weekly kudos are not known. A kudos is a reward the person gives; "kudos" is both singular and plural in English.

commentPin.kudos.costRemaining_one.text: Costs 1 kudos. {{count}} of {{limit}} left this week.
commentPin.kudos.costRemaining_one.description: Tooltip of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), and said to screen readers after it. {{count}} is how many kudos the person can still give this week and {{limit}} their weekly allowance.

commentPin.kudos.costRemaining_other.text: Costs 1 kudos. {{count}} of {{limit}} left this week.
commentPin.kudos.costRemaining_other.description: Tooltip of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), and said to screen readers after it. {{count}} is how many kudos the person can still give this week and {{limit}} their weekly allowance.

commentPin.kudos.label.description: Label of a switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): puts one of the person's weekly kudos on the request, as a reward for whoever solves it.

commentPin.kudos.noneLeft.description: Shown at the end of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the person has no kudos left to give this week; the switch is then off and disabled.

commentPin.kudos.left_one.description: Short count at the end of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): how many kudos the person can still give this week.

commentPin.kudos.left_other.description: Short count at the end of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): how many kudos the person can still give this week.

commentPin.kudos.costAfterCount.description: Hidden text read only by screen readers right after the kudos count at the end of the kudos switch in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) (for example "3 left"): the full stop ends that count, then {{cost}} is the sentence about what a kudos costs, for example "Costs 1 kudos. 3 of 10 left this week." Keep the punctuation that ends the count before {{cost}}.

commentPin.shot.attachedMany.text: Screenshot of this page, with your pins
commentPin.shot.attachedMany.description: Line beside the screenshot thumbnails in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), when the request has several comments: screenshots showing where the person placed each pin will be attached.

commentPin.shot.full_one.description: Line beside the pictures in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the request holds as many pictures as it can. {{used}} is how many it holds and {{count}} the most it can carry.

commentPin.shot.full_other.description: Line beside the pictures in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the request holds as many pictures as it can. {{used}} is how many it holds and {{count}} the most it can carry.

commentPin.shot.removeLabel.description: Accessible name of the small ✕ on the screenshot thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): posts the request without the screenshots.

commentPin.image.numbered.description: Name of an image in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) that the form handed over and that has no file name of its own: its place among them. Its thumbnail's description for screen readers.

commentPin.image.pasted.description: Name of an image the person pasted or attached in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) that has no file name of its own. Its thumbnail's description for screen readers.

commentPin.image.remove.description: Accessible name of the small ✕ on an image's thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): takes that image off the request. {{name}} is the image's file name.

commentPin.image.removeNumbered.description: Accessible name of the small ✕ on an image's thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), for an image the form handed over without a file name: takes it off the request. {{number}} is its place among those images.

commentPin.image.removePasted.description: Accessible name of the small ✕ on an image's thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), for an image without a file name of its own: takes it off the request.

commentPin.image.removeTitle.description: Tooltip of the small ✕ on an image's thumbnail in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): takes that image off the request.

commentPin.next.where.text: Click on the page where it goes
commentPin.next.where.description: Row in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) after the person chose to add another comment to the same request: their next click on the page places it. Beside it, a Cancel button.

commentPin.view.chip.description: Small label on the picture of the page shown while comment mode is on: says the page behind is a picture of the page, not the live page.

commentPin.marker.numbered.description: First part of the accessible name of the numbered marker a posted comment leaves on the page in comment mode; the request's place follows it. {{number}} is the comment's number within its request.

commentPin.marker.single.description: First part of the accessible name of the marker a posted comment leaves on the page in comment mode, when its request had only one comment; the request's place follows it. A noun.

commentPin.draftPin.number.description: First part of the accessible name of the pin of a comment not posted yet, on the page in comment mode. {{number}} is the comment's number within the request.

commentPin.draftPin.unposted.description: Second part of the accessible name of the pin of a comment on the page in comment mode, after "Comment 2": the comment has not been posted yet. Lower case; it follows the first part.

commentPin.box.label.description: Accessible name of the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), where the person writes the request their pins belong to.

commentPin.box.toForm.description: Tooltip and accessible name of an expand button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): moves everything written so far into the "Suggest an improvement" form instead.

commentPin.box.discardTitle.description: Tooltip of the ✕ button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): throws the request away. Esc is the keyboard key that does the same; keep it.

commentPin.box.discardLabel.description: Accessible name of the ✕ button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): throws the request away without posting it.

commentPin.textLabelNumbered.description: Accessible name of a comment's text box in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the request has several comments. {{number}} is the comment's number within the request.

commentPin.placeholderMore.description: Placeholder in the text box of a second or later comment in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): asks what else the person wants different at the spot they pinned.

commentPin.comment.change.description: Tooltip of a folded comment in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): opens it to change its words.

commentPin.comment.empty.description: Shown for a folded comment in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) that has no words yet.

commentPin.comment.removeLabel.description: Accessible name of the small ✕ beside a folded comment in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): takes that comment and its pin off the request. {{number}} is the comment's number.

commentPin.comment.removeTitle.description: Tooltip of the small ✕ beside a folded comment in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): takes that comment and its pin off the request.

commentPin.title.label.description: Label of the title row in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request), and the accessible name of its field: the title the request is posted with.

commentPin.title.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the title field in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request).

commentPin.title.writing.description: Shown in the title row of the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) while a title is being suggested from the person's words.

commentPin.title.change.description: Tooltip of the title in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): opens it to be changed.

commentPin.title.updating.description: Small note beside a suggested title in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) while a new suggestion is being made from the latest words.

commentPin.title.suggested.description: Small note beside the title in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): the title was suggested from the person's words, not typed by them.

commentPin.title.namedOnPost.text: Named from your words when posted
commentPin.title.namedOnPost.description: Shown in the empty title row of the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) once enough is written: a title will be made from the request's words when it is posted.

commentPin.title.asYouType.description: Shown in the empty title row of the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) before enough is written: a title will be suggested as the person writes.

commentPin.box.attachTitle.description: Tooltip of the paperclip button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): attaches images to the request; pasting an image into the comment works too.

commentPin.box.attachLabel.description: Accessible name of the paperclip button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): attaches images to the request.

commentPin.box.addCommentTitle.text: Add another comment to this same request: click where it goes next
commentPin.box.addCommentTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Add a comment" button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): the next click on the page places another comment of the same request.

commentPin.box.addComment.description: Button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request): adds another comment to the same request, placed by the next click on the page.

commentPin.postMany_one.description: Post button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the request has several comments. A verb. {{count}} is how many comments will be posted (always more than one in English).

commentPin.postMany_other.description: Post button in the comment box in comment mode (the box beside a pin where the person writes their request) when the request has several comments. A verb. {{count}} is how many comments will be posted together, as one request.

commentPin.card.comments_one.description: One fact on the card of a request already posted from comment mode: how many comments it held (shown only when more than one in English). Facts are joined by a middle dot.

commentPin.card.comments_other.description: One fact on the card of a request already posted from comment mode: how many comments it held. Facts are joined by a middle dot.

commentPin.card.images_one.description: One fact on the card of a request already posted from comment mode: it carried one picture. English spells the one out; a translation may use {{count}}. Facts are joined by a middle dot.

commentPin.card.images_other.description: One fact on the card of a request already posted from comment mode: how many pictures it carried. Facts are joined by a middle dot.

commentPin.card.kudos.description: One fact on the card of a request already posted from comment mode: the person put a kudos on it, as a reward for whoever solves it. Lower case; it may follow other facts.

commentPin.card.facts.description: How the facts on the card of a request already posted from comment mode are joined, for example "3 comments · 2 images · kudos for whoever solves it". {{first}} is everything said so far and {{second}} the next fact. Keep the middle dot unless your language separates them otherwise.

commentPin.card.open.description: Button on the card of a request already posted from comment mode: leaves comment mode and opens that request's page.

commentPin.intro.title.description: Heading, and accessible name, of the note shown the first time comment mode opens on a device. Comment mode is the layer where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot.

commentPin.intro.tap.text: Tap anything on the page to leave a comment right there, then press Post.
commentPin.intro.tap.description: First point of the note shown the first time comment mode opens on a device. Post is the name of the button that sends the comment; translate it as that button is translated.

commentPin.intro.drag.text: Drag the handle on the left to move the bar.
commentPin.intro.drag.description: Point of the note shown the first time comment mode opens on a device, when the bar floats over the page: its handle on the left moves it.

commentPin.intro.form.text: Prefer the form? Tap Form to switch back at any time.
commentPin.intro.form.description: Last point of the note shown the first time comment mode opens on a device. Form is the name of a switch on the bar; translate it as that switch is translated.

commentPin.intro.gotIt.description: Button that closes the note shown the first time comment mode opens on a device.

commentPin.bar.label.description: Accessible name of the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot). Comment mode is the name of the feature.

commentPin.bar.move.text: Move the bar: drag it anywhere, double-click to put it back
commentPin.bar.move.description: Accessible name of the handle at the left of the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot), when it floats over the page: dragging it moves the bar, a double-click puts it back at the bottom.

commentPin.bar.moveTitle.text: Drag to move the bar anywhere. Double-click to put it back at the bottom.
commentPin.bar.moveTitle.description: Tooltip of the handle at the left of the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot), when it floats over the page.

commentPin.bar.confirmDiscard.text: Discard this request? Nothing in it is posted yet.
commentPin.bar.confirmDiscard.description: Question on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) after the person asked to throw away a request they have written words in. Answered by Keep writing or Discard.

commentPin.bar.confirmExit.text: Discard the comments you haven't posted?
commentPin.bar.confirmExit.description: Question on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) when the person pressed Done with comments not posted yet. Answered by Keep writing or Discard (which leaves comment mode).

commentPin.bar.keepWriting.description: Button on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) that answers "Discard…?": keeps the unposted comments and goes back to writing.

commentPin.bar.discard.description: Button on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) that answers "Discard…?": throws the unposted comments away.

commentPin.bar.posted_one.description: Small count on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot): how many requests were posted since comment mode opened.

commentPin.bar.posted_other.description: Small count on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot): how many requests were posted since comment mode opened.

commentPin.bar.switchLabel.description: Accessible name of the Form / Comment switch on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot): the two ways to suggest an improvement.

commentPin.bar.formTitle.description: Tooltip of the Form side of the switch on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot): leaves comment mode for the "Suggest an improvement" form.

commentPin.bar.form.description: Form side of the Form / Comment switch on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot): the written form for suggesting an improvement. A noun.

commentPin.bar.commentTitle.description: Tooltip of the Comment side of the switch on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot), the side that is on: leaving comments pinned to the page.

commentPin.bar.comment.description: Comment side of the Form / Comment switch on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot), the side that is on: leaving comments pinned to the page. A noun or a verb, as fits a switch.

commentPin.bar.done.description: Button on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot): leaves comment mode (asking first when comments are not posted yet).

commentPin.bar.doneKey.description: Key cap shown inside the Done button on the bar of comment mode (a layer over the page where a click or tap leaves a comment pinned to that spot) on a computer: the Escape key does the same. Use the label this key has on keyboards in your language.
